mixed.label: Clean cards
mixed.question: Mix of face only, a card with your face in a rounded window, and full-screen cards. Serif key-word captions.
mixed.caption: duo
mixed.graphics: title card at frame 1; card or card + face every 2-4 s (diagram, checklist, counter, prompt, step header); icon stickers over the face for tools and objects; comment CTA at the end
mixed.tagline: Cards with your face in a window, key words in serif

studio.label: Bold B-roll
studio.question: Warm cinematic face, a hook title band, full-screen B-roll with big numbers for each point, stacked-word captions, glowing comment CTA and an end card.
studio.caption: stack
studio.graphics: 0-4 s: B-roll or device mock-up on top + band overlay (green l1, italic l2) at the seam, face below; then face full frame; every listed point = full-screen B-roll (user clips/screenshots, else device mock-up) 2.5-5 s with a bignum overlay; ctaword overlay on the 'comment X' line; endcard (2-5 s, black) last
studio.tagline: Hook title band, big numbers on phone shots, stacked words

simple.label: Face and captions
simple.question: Your face the whole time with zoom-ins, word-highlight captions and a title. Quickest to make.
simple.caption: karaoke
simple.graphics: title on frame 1; one or two chapter word cards; counter for numbers; nothing else
simple.tagline: Your face all the way, zoom-ins, word-highlight captions

news.label: AI News
news.tagline: You over the headline: screenshots zoom in, key lines highlighted
news.question: Your face in a bubble over full-screen screenshots of the news (articles, posts, product pages). Each screenshot zooms to the key line and a marker highlights it. A Breaking / New label, punchy captions.
news.caption: bold
news.graphics: first 2-3 s: your face full frame with a badge (type badge, text New or Breaking); then for every screenshot an insert mode bubble with gfx {type: shot, img, focus: 'x,y,w,h' of the key line as fractions of the image} for as long as you talk about it (face bubble bottom-left); back to the face for your opinion; comment CTA at the end

tutorial.label: Screen tutorial
tutorial.tagline: Your screen recording zooms to each click, your face in a bubble
tutorial.question: Your screen recording fills the screen and zooms to wherever you click or type, your face in a bubble in the corner, step badges and the prompt you typed shown clearly. Face full screen for the intro and the result. No recording? The screen is built with graphics: an app mock-up that types the prompt and clicks.
tutorial.learned_from: AI tool tutorial format (FocuSee / Tella / Trupeer style auto-zoom; research 2026-11-28)
tutorial.caption: minimal
tutorial.graphics: intro on the face; run scripts/screen_zoom.py on the screen recording (--top 0.04 --area 0.58) and use it as an insert mode bubble with src screen_vertical.mp4 (ss to line it up with what you say); badge overlays 'Step n of m' (tone blue) at each step; a prompt graphic when a prompt is read out; result on the face
